purpose: Sends everything in an image tool's output folder to the Recycle Bin on a schedule, stopping at 90% of the bin limit.
owner_approval: registering the scheduled task (the owner does it himself)
never a permanent delete or emptying the bin
evaluation: --dry-run prints count, size and bin headroom and moves nothing; --execute sends files to the bin only, skips files under 60 minutes old, stops at 90% of the bin limit, logs one line to a log file.

provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Windows-only (Shell API, registry bin settings); on Linux swap the mover for gio trash.
